en.p: A quartic function $f(x)$ with leading coefficient $1$ satisfies the following conditions.

box: (A) The maximum value of the real number $a$ with $f'(a)\le 0$ is $2$.
(B) The minimum value of the real number $k$ for which the set $\{x\mid f(x)=k\}$ has at least 3 elements is $\dfrac{8}{3}$.

en.p: When $f(0)=0$ and $f'(1)=0$, find the value of $f(3)$. [4 points]
